programs.name: Code Heroes: Virtual Reality
programs.description: This course introduces students to key computer science concepts through playful, creative virtual reality projects. Using DelightEx Edu, students design interactive 3D worlds and simple games while building confidence with events, loops, variables, and conditionals. The course encourages curiosity, collaboration, and responsible technology use through a flexible mix of guided, team, and independent projects. No prior coding experience is required. All equipment is provided!

programs.name: Creative Heroes: Animation Studio: Stop-Motion & Design
programs.description: Students are introduced to software-based stop-motion and animation design, learning to plan scenes, create characters, capture movement, and assemble finished short films. The class builds visual storytelling skills, attention to detail, and the ability to see a multi-step creative project through to completion. An ideal option for creative students who love animation and want a more technically involved process than a typical art class offers.

programs.name: STEM Explorers: Tinker Lab
programs.description: Creativity meets engineering! Using Strawbees building kits, students will design and build their own hands-on projects ranging from simple shapes to moving machines. Along the way, they’ll explore the basics of engineering design. This class is all about experimenting, tinkering, and having fun while bringing ideas to life!

programs.name: Creative Explorers: Stop-Motion Movie Makers
programs.description: Lights, camera, animate! In this creative program, students are introduced to stop motion animation. To start the course, students design scenes and bring them to life using frame-by-frame animation techniques. In the course, students learn how to use digital animation tools on iPads to create frame-by-frame animations and movies. This class blends art, storytelling, and technology in a fun, supportive way—perfect for imaginative kids who love movies and animation. All levels welcome.

programs.name: STEM Juniors: Tinker Lab
programs.description: Enjoy building? Tinker Lab is where creativity and engineering come together! Through fun, interactive projects, students will build, design, and experiment with everyday materials, discovering how things work by taking them apart and putting them back together. Each activity encourages kids to think like engineers, solving problems through trial, error, and teamwork. As they tinker with different tools and concepts, students will develop their problem-solving skills and gain confidence.

They’ll learn how to design characters, develop with exciting plots, and use interactive elements to make their stories fun and engaging.
